# storekit

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/internal/kit/storekit"
```

Package storekit is what framework/kit/store plugs into kit: the engines kit's stores run on — the SDK's document store in memory, in the data directory and over SQL —, kit's scope on a database — the SDK's transaction manager, its check and its migrator — and the migrations of kit's tables (ADR 0179 §1). kit's core imports neither the SDK's docstore nor its sql: it reaches them through plug, and a product that declares no store links none of them.

Package storekit — the compile-time proof that the engines are kit's.
